report: Valanga di neve bagnata ha chiuso due impianti per 3 giorni. Abbiamo spostato il personale sulle piste alte.
report_en: A wet snow avalanche closed two lifts for 3 days. We moved staff to the high slopes.

report: Zu wenig Naturschnee im Dezember. Wir haben zusätzliche Beschneiung eingesetzt, Kosten stiegen um 20 Prozent.
report_en: Too little natural snow in December. We used extra artificial snow, costs rose by 20 percent.

report: Tempête violente, télésiège fermé une journée. Nous avons mis en place des alertes SMS pour les clients.
report_en: Violent storm, chairlift closed for a day. We set up SMS alerts for customers.

report: Starke Regenfälle haben den Hang instabil gemacht. Wir haben einen Lift im Sommer für Wanderer geöffnet.
report_en: Heavy rain made the slope unstable. We opened a lift in summer for hikers.

report: Pochi turisti a gennaio per mancanza di neve. Abbiamo lanciato un'offerta per attività alternative.
report_en: Few tourists in January due to lack of snow. We launched an offer for alternative activities.
